description: This file contains the implementation of the HTTP/1.x protocol layer for the server, including functions for sending responses, handling headers, parsing request headers, managing request bodies (including chunked transfer encoding), and connection timeouts.

methods.name: int h1_send_1xx_info(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Send a 1xx informational response to the client, handling partial writes and accounting.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_send_1xx(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Construct and send an HTTP/1.1 1xx response, including headers and possibly the informational body.

methods.name: int h1_send_100_continue(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
__attribute_cold__ void h1_send_headers_partial_1xx(request_st * const r,buffer * const b)
methods.description: Move data from the connection's write queue into a buffer to send previous 1xx interim responses.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ chunk * h1_discard_blank_line(chunkqueue * const cq,uint32_t header_len)
methods.description: Discard a blank line in headers, used during header parsing.

methods.name: chunk * h1_recv_headers_more(connection * const con,chunkqueue * const cq,chunk * c,const size_t olen)
methods.description: Read more header data into the buffer when headers are incomplete.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_check_upgrade(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Check for and handle HTTP upgrade headers, e.g., for WebSocket or HTTP/2.

methods.name: int h1_recv_headers(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Parse HTTP request headers, manage connection states, handle pipeline, and detect protocol upgrades.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_check_expect_100(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Handle Expect: 100-continue header, conditionally sending the interim response.

methods.name: int h1_cq_compact(chunkqueue * const cq)
methods.description: Combine adjacent memory chunks in the chunkqueue for efficiency.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int h1_chunked_crlf(chunkqueue * const cq)
methods.description: Validate the terminating CRLF sequence in chunked transfer encoding.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int h1_chunked_400_bad_request(request_st * const r,const char * errstr)
methods.description: Log an error and return a 400 status code for invalid chunked data.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int h1_chunked_trailers(request_st * const restrict r,char * restrict t,uint32_t tlen)
methods.description: Parse and process trailer headers after a chunked request body.

methods.name: int h1_chunked(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,chunkqueue * const dst_cq)
methods.description: Handle chunked transfer encoding, read chunks, trailers, and manage errors.

methods.name: int h1_read_body_unknown(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,chunkqueue * const dst_cq)
methods.description: Read request body when the size is unknown, ensuring max request size is not exceeded.

methods.name: handler_t h1_reqbody_read(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Read and process the request body, supporting chunked transfer and other encodings.

methods.name: int h1_check_timeout(connection * const con,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Check for connection timeouts based on request or connection state and update accordingly.
